Automatic updates install again for portable copies.

**Updating from v0.2.0-alpha.1 or earlier:** in a portable copy, "Restart to update" in those
versions reopened the same version instead of installing the update. If your copy has not downloaded
an update yet, it installs this one by itself: restart when it says "New version is ready". If it
already shows an older update as ready and the restart does nothing, install that update once by hand
(steps in "Users stuck on a broken updater" in the repository's `docs/RELEASING.md`), or download the
portable zip below and unzip it over your Rustgram folder while Rustgram is closed.

## Highlights

- **Updates install when you restart.** "Restart to update" installs the downloaded version in
  portable copies, also when your data lives in `%APPDATA%\Rustgram` or in a
  `RustgramForcePortable` folder.

Plus N more fixes.

<details>
<summary>All changes</summary>

### Fixed

- The updater runs in Rustgram's data folder, where the update is downloaded, so "Restart to update"
  no longer reopens the old version.
- The updater also finds an update downloaded by v0.2.0-alpha.1 or earlier, so those versions can
  update to this one by themselves.

</details>

## Install or update

- **Installer:** `Rustgram-Setup-0.2.0-alpha.2-win-x64.exe`.
- **Portable:** unzip `rustgram-0.2.0-alpha.2-win-x64-portable.zip` and run `rustgram.exe`.
- Installed copies update themselves (pre-releases: beta channel only).
- Check a download: `gh attestation verify <file> -R murmaider227/rustgram`, or compare it with
  `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
